comparator.name: Chemistry
comparator.route: Chemistry of Life specialisation with University Minor
comparator.sourceNotes: The formally adopted 2026–2027 Chemistry regulations account for the full 180 EC. Year 1 is twelve compulsory 5-EC courses. The remaining 120 EC comprise ten further compulsory 5-EC chemistry courses, one 20-EC specialization, a 5-EC Research Practical, a 15-EC Bachelor Research Project and a 30-EC minor. The generic target offers Chemistry of Life, Smart Materials, and Sustainable Chemistry and Energy. No option is clearly more general, so Chemistry of Life is selected by the formal regulations’ official-order tie-break, independently of UCR fit. The genuine 30-EC University Minor remains open choice space.

routeSelection.route: Chemistry of Life specialisation with University Minor
routeSelection.basis: The generic Chemistry target offers three formally named 20-EC specialisations. Current official evidence does not establish one as more representative or less specialised than the others, so the first specialisation in the formally adopted 2026–2027 regulations, Chemistry of Life, is selected as the neutral tie-break. The University Minor preserves the regulated open 30-EC minor space. Neither choice is based on UCR fit.

exception.reason: The University of Groningen programme is a cumulative experimental Chemistry degree. Its defining spine includes molecular structure and reactivity, organic, inorganic, physical and quantum chemistry, spectroscopy, transport phenomena, materials, chemical safety, multiple synthesis and analysis laboratories, a 20-EC chemistry specialisation, a research practical and a 15-EC experimental research project. UCR offers valuable biology, biochemistry, biomedical science, mathematics, programming, data science and one life-science laboratory course, but no general, organic, inorganic or physical chemistry sequence, no spectroscopy or chemical-analysis sequence, no chemical-transport or quantum-chemistry course, and no staged synthesis/analysis laboratory formation. Even the selected Chemistry of Life specialisation rests on that missing chemistry core. A UCR programme assembled from biological and quantitative courses would therefore be a molecular-biomedicine programme, not a defensible Chemistry comparator.
exception.curriculumContext: The formal 2026–2027 Chemistry appendix supplies all 180 EC: twelve 5-EC first-year units; ten further compulsory 5-EC chemistry units; the 20-EC Chemistry of Life specialisation; a 5-EC Research Practical; a 15-EC Bachelor Research Project; and a genuine 30-EC University Minor. The regulations also document the staged entry requirements for practicals and the research project.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR workbook rows, including names, descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned Fall 2026 cohort terms. HCBGATE101 Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine, HCBLIFE211 Molecular Cell Biology, HCBLIFE213 Biochemistry, HCBLIFE212 Human Physiology and HCBLIFE311 Molecular Pathology & Genetics provide biological and molecular foundations. HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory adds biochemical and molecular laboratory work, including bacterial techniques, protein production, DNA analysis and basic bioinformatics. HCBBIOM311 Pharmacology, HCBBIOM312 Infection & Immunity and HCBBIOM313 Mechanisms of Disease extend medicines and disease biology. DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus, DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming and data-science courses provide useful quantitative support. The workbook contains no general-chemistry foundation, organic-chemistry sequence, inorganic chemistry, physical chemistry, quantum chemistry, spectroscopy, chemical analysis, transport phenomena, molecular/materials design, polymer chemistry, catalysis sequence, chemical safety course, synthesis laboratory or staged chemical research practical. HCBLIFE213 and HCBLIFE214 are valuable single biochemistry and life-science-laboratory courses but cannot replace the target’s chemistry doctrine, instrumentation and experimental formation. The closest UCR combination would omit most of the compulsory Chemistry core and cannot honestly be presented as a match.
